description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the non-Yomiji legendary creature.
Yomiji and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Yomiji trigger, returning the legendary card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting that card onto the battlefield from your hand and attaching Deathrender to it.
When the creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger from step 1, dealing 1 damage.
Repeat.
